description: Defines the BufferResult class, a container for request-response service invocation results, including status, payload, content type, and application properties.

classes.name: BufferResult
classes.description: A final class extending RequestResponseResult<Buffer>, representing the result of a request-response operation with methods to create instances with various parameters and retrieve content type.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory methods to create BufferResult instances with different combinations of status, payload, content type, and application properties.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the media type of the payload, or null if unknown.
